citation: Tramelli et al. (2021), Scientific Reports 11, 7211, Table 1, doi:10.1038/s41598-021-86506-6
convention: Piecewise constant layers; depths of tops in km below sea level, Vp and Vs in km/s. Vs=Vp/1.78. First layer extended above sea level for station elevations; last layer extended to the bottom of the computational domain.
status: Published alternative, NOT verified as the exact Calo--Tramelli 2018 GaMMA starting model
use: Exploratory GaMMA association and separate VELEST precision experiment only. The unverified fixed 3D grid and previous regional averages are quarantined; no independent regional calibration accepted.
